titles.title: Ceramic Tile Dataset: 3301 Segmented Tiles with Shape and Colour Metrics

descriptions.description: Binary masks, mean colours and shape metrics for 3301 individual physical ceramic tiles. Tiles were photographed on a calibrated board, located with ArUco fiducials for metric scale, and segmented with a YOLO detector followed by SAM2. Each tile carries its cropped binary mask, bounding box, capture timestamp, pixel-to-millimetre scaling factor, mean RGB colour, a quantised palette colour, and six shape descriptors: area in pixels and square millimetres, eccentricity, solidity, aspect ratio, compactness and circularity. The dataset is the tile inventory used by the surface-mosaic packing method described in the related publication.

Tiles were laid out individually on a flat board carrying ArUco fiducial markers (DICT_7X7_250, 50 mm) and photographed at 4032x3024 px. The fiducials give each capture a pixel-to-millimetre scale. Tiles were localised with a YOLO detector fine-tuned on this tile domain, and each detection was refined into a pixel-accurate mask with SAM2 (sam2.1_hiera_small). Each mask was cropped to its bounding box plus a 1 px margin. Shape descriptors (area, eccentricity, solidity, aspect ratio, compactness, circularity) were computed from the full-resolution mask with scikit-image regionprops; areas were converted to mm^2 using the per-capture scaling factor. The mean RGB of each tile surface was recorded and additionally quantised to the 12 physical glaze colours by HSV-aware matching (hue distance for chromatic tiles, value distance for achromatic ones).

Generated with Python 3.11, PyTorch, SAM2, Ultralytics YOLO, OpenCV (ArUco), scikit-image, NumPy and h5py. Reuse requires only an HDF5 reader; the included plot_tiles.py needs Python >=3.11 with h5py, NumPy and Matplotlib (pinned in uv.lock).

masks/<id>.description: One tight binary mask per tile, cropped to the tile plus a 1 px margin; the group member name is the zero-padded tile id.

bboxes.description: Position of each crop in the original 4032x3024 capture frame as [y0, y1, x0, x1], end-exclusive.

colors.description: Mean RGB colour of the tile surface.

true_colors.description: Colour quantised to the 12-colour physical palette (HSV-aware matching).

scaling_factors.description: Pixel-to-millimetre scale from the ArUco fiducials.

eccentricity.description: Eccentricity of the equivalent ellipse; 0 is a circle.

solidity.description: Area divided by convex-hull area; 1 is convex.

aspect_ratio.description: Major axis divided by minor axis of the equivalent ellipse.
